y01-art-and-design.description:
Art & Design for Year 1 (ages 5–6) — a bright, story-led pupil book from the Prime Books Cambridge Early Years collection.

Built for young children taking their first steps in Art & Design, this 89-page book turns every lesson into a story. Friendly characters guide pupils through each topic, with big colourful pictures, simple instructions, and short hands-on activities that keep little hands busy and curious minds engaged.

What makes this book work in the classroom:
• Story-based learning — each unit opens with an illustrated story that introduces the topic in language a young child understands.
• Talk about it — prompts that get children discussing, pointing, asking and answering, building vocabulary and confidence.
• Try it yourself — hands-on activities, drawing, matching, counting, tracing or making, matched to what was just learned.
• Check my learning — gentle end-of-unit checks so teachers and parents can see progress without any test anxiety.
• Big pages, big print — layout designed for small readers: short lines, generous white space, and artwork on every spread.

The book follows the Cambridge Early Years framework, giving schools a ready-to-teach resource that needs no extra preparation: open the page, read the story, do the activity. Parents using it at home will find the same structure — nothing to plan, everything already sequenced.

A full year of classroom-ready Art & Design for the price of one book: stories, activities, vocabulary and checks, all in one place — the pupil book your Year 1 class will want to pick up.

This 176-page book supports the full depth and demand of the AS/A Level Spanish A Level course. It is written for students who need more than content: they need argument, analysis and the exam craft to express both under time pressure.

The book's approach:
• Syllabus-complete content, structured so each chapter builds the conceptual chains A Level examiners expect students to travel.
• Worked analytical examples that model how to break down extended questions and construct full-mark responses.
• Exam-style practice throughout — including the long structured essays and applied problems that decide top grades.
• Synoptic links flagged across topics, preparing students for questions that reach across the whole syllabus.
• Revision and consolidation sections designed for the final months before papers.

Written to be written in, the book carries the student from first teaching through independent revision — a single volume that replaces the textbook/workbook/revision-guide stack.

For schools and independent candidates alike: a complete, self-contained AS & A Level Spanish A Level resource that treats the exam not as an afterthought but as a skill to be taught.
